important.delete_param_name: Some deletes take `delete_list` (the UI's paramsubmit), others take the id field. Choosing the wrong one changes behaviour. See the house finding.
important.house_delete_delete_list: CORRECTED 2026-11-15. /json/options/delhouseflex with `delete_list` returns success but deletes nothing: houses 90 and 92 were still listed afterwards (confirmed by the contract run). With `houseid` it returns error 8 when users reference the house and deletes the house otherwise (house 91 was deleted this way). An earlier version of this file called delete_list an in-use-check bypass that orphaned user references. That was wrong; nothing is orphaned. The MCP sends `houseid` only.
